title: NamePlayers+
description: This projects add a nicknaming for paper plugins
body:
You can change nicknames with these commands:

/name <player> <nickname>

You can clear the nickname with this command:
/name clear <player>



This Plugin was made by Cursor AI so it is probably not the best but it easy to use.
If u clear a nickname the skin won't change back I will try fixing that and I will also try to add a command to change everyones nickname to random ones.
